description.text: Program Description The major of international economy and trade trains students to systematically master the basic principles of economics and the basic theories of international economy and international trade, and master the basic knowledge and skills of international trade. Contemporary understanding of China's foreign trade and international economic and trade development present situation, familiar with common international trade practice and the WTO rules, and China's foreign trade policy laws and regulations, understand the status of the foreign trade of main countries and regions, in the foreign economic and trade sector, foreign companies and government institutions and research institutes engaged in international economy and trade business, management, research and teaching and research work, the applied senior specialized talents. Duration 4 years

duration.text: The International Economics and Trade at Tongji University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3416 USD/per year ￥ 24600 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Level 3 or above

requirements.text: English Requirement: applicants are required to master English words more than the amount of 3000;
